circuit.name: Dual Active Bridge DC-DC Converter
circuit.description: Bidirectional isolated DC-DC converter with two full H-bridges, high-frequency isolation transformer T1, and a series-damped leakage inductor LLk. Regulates 60V DC bus into a 1.25 Ohm / 4.7mF RC load (2880W) via a closed-loop critically damped PI controller with pole-zero cancellation and active phase-shift modulation at 20kHz.
models: .model nmos_model NMOS(Vto=3 Lambda=0.01 Kp=73 Cbd=1n Cbs=1n Cgdo=100p Is=1e-14 Rs=0.01)
.model Dmodel D(Is=1e-12 n=1.1 Rs=0.0001 Cjo=3e-11 Bv=1000 Ibv=1e-06)

requirements.requirement: Verify DAB closed-loop voltage regulation to 60V and power transfer into 1.25 Ohm RC load via active phase-shift modulation

data.name: Vout_avg
data.description: Average Output Voltage in steady state (last 20ms)
